description: This file defines a Java class 'DebugPanel' that extends JPanel. It creates a UI component displaying an exception message, some static information, and a URL in a Swing application. The panel includes labels, a text area for exception details, and a custom URL component.

classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass that displays exception details, a product message, and a URL for debugging purposes.
